name: The Legacy Heart
summary: Dark magic clings to the Legacy Heart, a relic sought alongside two other items of power. Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge wants it for a purpose tied to Yagyin's Digest.

sections.title: A Relic of Power
sections.body: Gerrig Bonegrip asks for the Legacy Heart among three relics he has written on Bonegrip's Note. He will trade the digest for them, but keeps their names from spoken ears. The Heart's dark enchantment has earned it a fearsome reputation.

faq.answer: The Legacy Heart is a relic of power sought by Gerrig Bonegrip in exchange for Yagyin's Digest.
Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge asks for the Legacy Heart and two other relics.
Gerrig needs the Legacy Heart with two other relics before he will give up Yagyin's Digest.

faq.q: What is the Heart said to do?
faq.answer: Dark magic is said to grant the Legacy Heart's holder immortality; its current owner bears the title the Undying.

faq.q: What other relics does Gerrig seek?
faq.answer: Gerrig asks for the Star of Xil'yeh, the Hand of Dagun and the Legacy Heart.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can bring the Legacy Heart and two other relics to Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge in exchange for Yagyin's Digest.

attribution: The Star, the Hand and the Heart (Alliance)
